tools.name: query_composition
tools.description: Return the cell-type composition of REAL HNOCA cells matching a filter on protocol and/or age range. Use for 'what cells are in protocol X at age Y?' questions.

tools.name: gene_expression_timecourse
tools.description: Mean log1p expression of one gene across age bins, optionally restricted to a single protocol. Use for 'how does gene X change with organoid age?' questions.

tools.name: predict_composition_at_age
tools.description: Predict cell-type composition for a (protocol, target age) pair by kNN retrieval over real HNOCA cells at the nearest available ages. Use for 'what should my Velasco day-100 organoid look like?' questions.

tools.name: find_similar_cells
tools.description: Given a (protocol, age) query, return what dominates its k nearest neighbours in the atlas's 30-D PCA latent space — which protocols and cell types it sits near. The analogue of 'projecting a sample into the atlas to see what it looks like'.

tools.name: classify_cell_type
tools.description: Run a HNOCA-trained cell-type classifier (logreg or kNN over a 30-D PCA latent) on cells of a (protocol, age) cohort. Returns predicted composition + per-label confidence.

tools.name: pubmed_search
tools.description: Search PubMed via NCBI E-utilities. Returns up to retmax records: {pmid, title, year, journal}. Use this for any literature question — do NOT invent PMIDs.

tools.name: fetch_abstract
tools.description: Fetch the abstract text for one PubMed PMID via NCBI E-utilities. Returns {pmid, title, year, journal, abstract}.
